title: New strict_spawn_class helper triggers 134 bad-free errors per `odin test core` run (temp_allocator make + defer delete mismatch)
evidence:
core/growth_test.odin:527-529:
	parent := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(parent)
core/growth_test.odin:556-558:
	size := make([]i32, n, context.temp_allocator)
	defer delete(size)
Runtime (odin test core, this worktree at 26eb4e5): "+++ bad free @ 0x4D7800340 [growth_test.odin:528:strict_spawn_class()]" / "[growth_test.odin:557:strict_spawn_class()]" — 136 bad frees total per run; only the other 2 (health_test.odin:877/910) predate this PR (health_test.odin is untouched by 26eb4e5).
detail: Slices allocated from context.temp_allocator are freed by delete via the tracking allocator — a bad free every call. Tests still exit 0, so CI (tools/ci-local.sh:56 `odin test core`) stays green while tracker output is drowned, masking genuine sim-code allocation regressions.
recommended_fix: Either drop the two `defer delete` lines (temp memory is freed wholesale per test) or allocate with `make([]i32, n)` from context.allocator so delete matches. Re-run `odin test core` to confirm zero growth_test bad frees.

title: Map-diameter bound on new_area_seed_tiles has no accept-side boundary row (49 on the 40x30 map) and the parsed value is never asserted
evidence:
core/catalog_test.odin:720-721 (the only diameter rows):
		{"seed_tiles at map diameter", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 10`, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 50`, 1), "growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles"},
		{"seed_tiles above map diameter", replace1(BAL_VALID, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 10`, `"new_area_seed_tiles": 51`, 1), "growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles"},
core/catalog.odin:1015-1016: `if i64(b.growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles)*i64(b.growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles) >= i64(b.map_w_tiles)*i64(b.map_w_tiles) + i64(b.map_h_tiles)*i64(b.map_h_tiles) {` — BAL_VALID map is 40x30 (diameter 50), so 49 is the largest legal value.
detail: Only reject rows (50, 51) exist; 49 loads clean but is untested, and no positive row asserts the parsed value (the bias-750 row asserts its parsed value; new_area_seed_tiles never is). An off-by-one loosening would pass unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add a positive row loading new_area_seed_tiles 49 clean, and extend the existing 750-row (or a new one) with expect_value(balance.growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles, 10).

title: growth_seed_sep_ok's fail-closed degenerate guard (min_dist < 1) is untested while the sibling attach predicate's guard is pinned
detail: The new predicate's degenerate branch has zero coverage while its mirrored sibling's branch is explicitly pinned — asymmetric guard coverage; a regression to fail-open (accepting everything) would not fail any test.
recommended_fix: Add to test_growth_seed_sep_predicate: `testing.expect(t, !growth_seed_sep_ok(&s.topology, {30, 15}, 0), "a zero seed floor must never accept")` mirroring the attach pin at line 831.
